sources.title: Qwen
sources.snippet: Base Model: A Good Starting Point for Alignment The general procedure of building an assistant model includes pretraining and post-training, where the latter mostly consists of SFT and RLHF. As to pretraining, similar to previous LLM, GPT-3, Llama, Qwen is a Transformer-based language model pretrained by the task of next token prediction.
